suggestions.text: Remove the unused #[Title('My genetics')] now that the profile is embedded in the dashboard tab
Point login redirect at route('home', ['tab' => 'genetics']) to skip the /genetics redirect hop
Add a guest test for the upload action (401, no GeneticUpload row) now that the profile sits on the public dashboard route
Send Cache-Control: no-store on authenticated dashboard responses, since genotype HTML is now served from the public / URL
